map.施工工序工期排程 使用指南: Construction Task Duration Scheduler User Guide
map.基于关键路径法（CPM）自动计算工期、总时差与关键路径，并绘制甘特图。: Uses the critical path method (CPM) to compute the duration, total float and critical path automatically, and draws a Gantt chart.
map.家装全流程排程：录入拆改→水电→泥瓦→木工→油漆→安装各工序工期与先后依赖，求出: Full home-renovation scheduling: enter the durations and dependencies of demolition, plumbing/electrical, masonry, carpentry, painting and installation, then obtain the critical path and the total duration.
map.并行工序优化：识别非关键工序总时差，在不影响总工期下灵活插入定制家具等待等空闲。: Parallel task optimisation: identify the total float of non-critical tasks and use it to absorb idle time such as waiting for custom furniture without extending the overall duration.
map.延期影响评估：某工序延期时，看是否落在关键路径上，判断对交付日的影响。: Delay impact assessment: when a task slips, check whether it sits on the critical path to judge the effect on the delivery date.
map.：示例：拆改 3d→水电 7d→泥瓦 10d→木工 8d→油漆 6d（串行）。\:
Example: demolition 3d → plumbing/electrical 7d → masonry 10d → carpentry 8d → painting 6d (serial).
• Critical path total = 3+7+10+8+6 = 34d
• If 2d of masonry runs in parallel as a base layer, the total duration can be compressed
map.决定总工期的最长工序链，任一环节延期都会推后交付；非关键链有浮动时间。: The longest chain of tasks that determines the overall duration; any delay on it pushes back delivery, while non-critical chains carry float.
map.依赖关系怎么填？: How do I fill in the dependency relationship?
map.用「前置工序→本工序」表达先后，如水电必须在泥瓦前完成；并行用无依赖表示。: Express sequence with "preceding task → this task", for example plumbing/electrical must finish before masonry; use no dependency for parallel tasks.
map.结果能当合同工期吗？: Can the result be treated as the contract duration?
map.本工具按输入估算理想工期，不含天气/返工/待料等风险，实际需留缓冲并签约定。: This tool estimates the ideal duration from the input and excludes risks such as weather, rework and material waits; in practice you must leave a buffer and sign an agreement.
